title: Ablation del voto analogico nel motore SONAR ibrido
hypothesis: Il componente analog_successor_votes (overlap storico >=3, peso overlap^3, coefficiente 0.10) aggiunge informazione predittiva incrementale al ranking ibrido SONAR, oltre alle componenti di frequenza, persistenza e presenza recente.

source.pending_target_policy: Exclude from canonical historical scoring until the official VinciCasa archive publishes the result; do not use third-party-only outcome.

walk_forward.prior_only_rule: For target index t, pass exactly draws[0:t] to each scorer; no target or later row is available to feature computation.
walk_forward.scorer_source: Extract exact overlapCount, sonarTransitionProfile and sonarAnalogCore from the pinned committed src/VinciCasaLab.jsx.
walk_forward.ablation: Replace only the analog_successor_votes coefficient 0.10 with 0; divide the six remaining coefficients by 0.90. Preserve every feature, normalization, tie-break and data prefix.

comparators.full_engine: Exact source scorer with original weights 0.38,0.22,0.14,0.06,0.10,0.06,0.04.
comparators.no_analog: Same exact scorer and same feature matrix, with analog coefficient zero and remaining weights normalized by 0.90.
comparators.freq100: Top 20/10/5 from prior-100 draw inclusion counts, descending count, ascending numeric tie-break.
comparators.exact_uniform: Expected hits Top5=0.625, Top10=1.25, Top20=2.5; P(Top20 contains all five)=choose(20,5)/choose(40,5).

walk_forward.no_tuning: No weight search, no threshold search, no subgroup selection, no model selection on historical Blind OOS. Validation is descriptive only.

endpoints.primary: Historical Blind OOS paired mean Top20 hit difference: full engine minus no-analog ablation.
secondary: Blind OOS paired mean Top10 hit difference: full minus no-analog.
Blind OOS paired mean Top5 hit difference: full minus no-analog.
Blind OOS paired Top20 all-five rate difference: full minus no-analog.
The same four paired endpoints for full engine minus freq100.
null_controls: Full-engine Blind OOS Top20 all-five count against exact binomial null p=choose(20,5)/choose(40,5).
No-analog Blind OOS Top20 all-five count against the same exact null.
endpoints.direction: One-sided improvement; positive paired differences favor the first model.

inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across exactly ten inferential endpoints: eight paired sign-flip tests plus two exact binomial all-five tests.
inference.descriptive_only: Discovery/Validation/OOS means, Top20/Top10/Top5 hit distributions, overlap diagnostics and analog candidate prevalence.

integrity_checks: Canonical archive dates unique and strictly increasing; every row contains five distinct sorted integers in 1..40.
src/data.json modelDraws matches the canonical CSV row-for-row.
All three model rankings are complete permutations of 1..40 for every target.
Every forecast prefix ends strictly before the target date and contains no target row.
Mutating the target and all future outcomes does not alter a forecast computed from the unchanged prior prefix at nine fixed cutoffs.
Every analog successor referenced by the scorer is at or before the final date of the prior prefix.
A synthetic no-analog history produces identical full and ablated ranks; a synthetic analog history changes analog feature scores but does not access future rows.
Deterministic report/ledger/checkpoint/manifest replay must match byte-for-byte.
guardrails: Research-only; do not change production scorer, shadow freezes, Q60, H101 or H102.
Do not append or evaluate the 2026-11-10 result until the official archive publishes it.
Historical Blind OOS has been exposed to prior research and is not a virgin prospective holdout.
No automatic merge, no engine promotion, and no modification of PR #6, #7 or #8.
